purpose: Teach: 移す/解き/外す/謙虚/造り/削っ/抱き/なさら

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、本社、絶対、移す、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need our headquarters move seriously considered — and I mean it. Make it happen.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped opening. Staccato emphasis on key words. Authoritative but not unkind. The weight of expectation landing firm. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、難題、絶対、解き、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're treating this as our priority and moving forward with urgency. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Measured, formal register. Steady pace, each phrase distinct. Respectful without obsequiousness. Slight nod in the voice — acknowledgment of the weight he's being given.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約の不要、絶対、条項、絶対、本気で、絶対、外す、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Strip out unnecessary contract clauses — that's what needs to happen. Push it forward.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Slight hardness on the verb. Not impatient, but unyielding. The tone of someone who doesn't repeat himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、謙虚、絶対、な姿勢、絶対、続けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team continues to approach this with humility and care. I appreciate your trust in us.
lines.style: Respectful, steady. Slight warmth underneath the formality — not defensive, but grounded. Speaks with the dignity of someone taking responsibility seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、新製品の、絶対、造り、絶対、磨け、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our new products need real polish. Excellence in execution — that's what I'm asking for.
lines.style: Firm and deliberate. Emphasis lands on 'excellence'. Not rushing, but brooking no negotiation. The voice of someone who sees the stakes clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、無駄な、絶対、コスト、絶対、削っ、絶対、ております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're cutting unnecessary costs and keeping focus where it matters. Thank you for the mandate.
lines.style: Professional, attentive. Quiet confidence — not defensive about efficiency, but matter-of-fact. Shows he's tracking both the direction and the reasoning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、抱き、絶対、込め、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep customers at the center of every decision we make.
lines.style: Quieter than before — almost intimate in intensity. The words carry weight because of their simplicity. No decoration, just principle. Spoken like something non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営者、本気で、絶対、なさら、絶対、ない、絶対、判断、絶対、伺いました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I understand your vision for how we should lead. I'm listening, and I'm committed to executing it.
lines.style: Humble, attentive. Slight pause before 'I understand' — not hesitation, but presence. Shows he's absorbed what wasn't explicitly said. Respectful close.
